overview_description.description: Lighter operates a decentralized exchange for digital-asset trading. Its Ethereum-based zero-knowledge rollup generates cryptographic proofs for operations including order matching, balance updates, and liquidations. The platform includes an order-book matching engine, risk engine, executor, and batch prover. Users can access the exchange through web and mobile applications, with settlement and proof verification connected to Ethereum.
